title: Solution scaffold and CI
acceptance: WHEN `dotnet build Miautrix.Mail.sln -warnaserror` runs on a clean checkout THE SYSTEM SHALL compile every project with zero warnings and exit 0.

title: Domain model and EF Core schema
acceptance: WHEN `dotnet ef database update` runs against an empty PostgreSQL database THE SYSTEM SHALL create every table in Section 5.2 with `tenant_id` and its index on every tenant-scoped table.

title: Seed data and indexes
acceptance: WHEN the seed runs against a freshly migrated database THE SYSTEM SHALL create the permission catalogue, and running it twice SHALL NOT duplicate rows.

title: Identity: credentials, MFA, sessions
acceptance: WHEN a user with TOTP enabled submits a correct password but no second factor THE SYSTEM SHALL refuse the login and SHALL write exactly one AUTH-4020 event.

title: Authorization, roles, and tenant isolation
acceptance: WHEN a user in tenant A requests a mailbox belonging to tenant B THE SYSTEM SHALL return 404 and SHALL NOT leak the resource's existence.

title: Audit trail
acceptance: WHEN an audited change is rolled back THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT persist its audit row.

title: SMTP listener and queue
acceptance: WHEN a message is accepted for a local recipient THE SYSTEM SHALL enqueue exactly one row in `smtp_queue`, and WHEN delivery fails THE SYSTEM SHALL schedule a retry with a delay strictly greater than the previous one.

title: SPF, DKIM, DMARC
acceptance: WHEN an outbound message leaves a domain with a DKIM key configured THE SYSTEM SHALL attach a DKIM-Signature header that verifies against the published public key.

title: Anti-spam baseline and quarantine
acceptance: WHEN a message exceeds the configured spam threshold THE SYSTEM SHALL store it in quarantine and SHALL NOT deliver it to the mailbox.

title: IMAP, storage abstraction, and attachments
acceptance: WHEN a client APPENDs a message and reconnects THE SYSTEM SHALL return the message with identical bytes and flags.

title: ManageSieve
acceptance: WHEN a script containing a syntax error is uploaded THE SYSTEM SHALL reject it with the line number and SHALL leave the previously active script unchanged.

title: Full-text search indexing
acceptance: WHEN a message is delivered THE SYSTEM SHALL make it findable by a full-text query within one second.

title: Mail-flow rule engine, simulator, explorer
acceptance: WHEN a rule is simulated against a sample message THE SYSTEM SHALL report every rule that matched and every action that would have fired, and SHALL NOT mutate any message.

title: API contract and OpenAPI
acceptance: WHEN a request omits a required field THE SYSTEM SHALL return 422 with field-level details and SHALL NOT return 200 with a success-false body.

title: Web admin GUI
acceptance: WHEN an administrator loads the queue screen THE SYSTEM SHALL render the queue with cursor pagination and SHALL issue no more than one request per screen.
verify: pnpm --filter admin test && pnpm --filter admin build

title: Webmail
acceptance: WHEN a message body containing a script tag is rendered THE SYSTEM SHALL sanitise it with DOMPurify and SHALL NOT execute the script.

title: CLI
acceptance: WHEN `miautrix-mail mailbox list --tenant <slug>` runs as an authorized operator THE SYSTEM SHALL print the tenant's mailboxes and exit 0.

title: Desktop admin application
acceptance: WHEN the packaged desktop app launches on a machine with no network THE SYSTEM SHALL render its bundled UI and SHALL NOT attempt to load remote content into the webview.
verify: pnpm --filter desktop test && pnpm --filter desktop build

title: Backup and restore
acceptance: WHEN `miautrix-mail backup` runs and the resulting archive is restored into a scratch database THE SYSTEM SHALL produce matching row counts for every table.

title: Blue/green update and migrations ladder
acceptance: WHEN a new release is staged and the health gate fails THE SYSTEM SHALL leave the previous release serving traffic and SHALL NOT flip the symlink.

title: Security hardening and licence gating
acceptance: WHEN a tenant is over its mailbox allowance THE SYSTEM SHALL block new mailbox creation, SHALL keep delivering mail for existing mailboxes, and SHALL NOT destroy any data.
